title: Item 14a · Picking a date
subtitle: Mixed: approved, planned, drift. Star has the shared date picker: a button that shows the date in words and opens a big month calendar. Everywhere else a date is the browser's own box — numbers like “11/20/2026” with a small calendar icon — which looks different on the desk PC, the iPad and a phone. Color Belt was approved to differ (v0.502); Black Belt planned to switch once Star's picker was on main — it is now (v0.911); Camps' other dates, Prospects, Schedule, Calendar and Forms never decided (drift). Item 14b, the time lists, comes next. (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

items.caption: 1. Star: the shared picker — the date in words, a big month calendar, “Past dates can't be chosen.”

3. Calendar: the same browser boxes, no day line.

columns.note: Browser boxes also in Black Belt (planned to switch), Camps' sign-up dates, Prospects' follow-up, Schedule, Forms and Finance's day box. Camps' calendar for choosing camp days is a different job (picking several days) and stays.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · Star's picker everywhere

items.caption: 4. Color Belt with Star's picker: the date in words; a tap opens the same big calendar on the PC, the iPad and a phone.

columns.note: Copies what's already there: Star's own picker, already on main. Picture 4 is drawn over the real Edit event box; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − two different ways to pick a date, and the browser's box changes from device to device.
B · Recommended: Star's date picker for every date staff or families pick — Color Belt, Black Belt (its own plan), Camps' sign-up dates, Prospects, Schedule, Calendar, Forms, Finance's day box, and the family pages' date of birth. Camps' camp-days calendar stays (a different job). + the same big, readable calendar everywhere, the same on every device; dates read as words (“Fri, Nov 20, 2026”), not numbers. − work in several sections (the picker exists; each date box is swapped).
C · Only the planned switch: Black Belt moves to Star's picker, as it planned; everyone else keeps the browser's box. + the least work. − two kinds of date box stay.
